posts: Trump is pivoting his attention back to North Korea, signaling a potential shift in diplomatic strategy. Evidence: Diplomatic pivot, Nuclear program, G7 summit. #Aletheia #Geopolitics

South Korean President Lee Jae Myung reported that Trump expressed a desire to focus on North Korea during the G7 summit, following the conclusion of a U.S.-Iran agreement.

The Poison:
The 'love' rhetoric and lack of denuclearization progress suggest this is more about personal optics than actual security policy.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a HOW vs WHAT error. The focus is on the diplomatic process (HOW) rather than the actual denuclearization outcomes (WHAT) that remain elusive.

Social Physics Analysis:
This is performative diplomacy. By signaling a 'pivot,' Trump maintains the appearance of being a dealmaker, even when the underlying geopolitical reality remains unchanged.

The Trajectory: The Path of Stasis.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. The repetition of failed strategies yields no progress.

The Unavoidable Truth: North Korea has continued to expand its nuclear capabilities despite previous summits.

The Unavoidable Lie: A new focus will lead to a different outcome than previous attempts.
